title: Dihydroartemisinin inhibits the development of colorectal cancer by GSK-3beta/TCF7/MMP9 pathway and synergies with capecitabine.
authors: Dai, Xiaoshuo; Chen, Wei; Qiao, Yan; Chen, Xinhuan; Chen, Yihuan; Zhang, Kai; Zhang, Qiushuang; Duan, Xiaoxuan; Li, Xiang; Zhao, Jimin; Tian, Fang; Liu, Kangdong; Dong, Ziming; Lu, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双氢青蒿素通过GSK-3beta/TCF7/MMP9通路抑制结直肠癌，虽涉及TCF7转录因子与DNA的ChIP和分子对接，但核心是药物抗癌机制，非TF-DNA互作建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅作为辅助验证。
abstract: Patients with colorectal cancer (CRC) suffer from poor prognosis and lack effective drugs. Dihydroartemisinin (DHA) has anti-cancer potential but the mechanism remains unclear. We elucidated the effects and mechanism of DHA on CRC development with the aim of providing an effective, low-toxicity drug and a novel strategy for CRC. Herein, proliferation assay, transwell assay, tube formation assay, metastasis models, PDX model and AOM/DSS model were used to reveal the effects of DHA on CRC. The key pathway and target were identified by RNA-seq, ChIP, molecular docking, pull down and dual-luciferase reporter assays. As a result, DHA showed a strong inhibitory effect on the growth, metastasis and angiogenesis of CRC with no obvious toxicity, and the inhibitory effect was similar to that of the clinical drug Capecitabine (Cap). Indeed, DHA directly targeted GSK-3beta to inhibit CRC development through the GSK-3beta/TCF7/MMP9 pathway. Meaningfully, DHA in combination with Cap enhanced the anti-cancer effect, and alleviated Cap-induced diarrhoea, immunosuppression and inflammation. In conclusion, DHA has the potential to be an effective and low-toxicity drug for the treatment of CRC. Furthermore, DHA in combination with Cap could be a novel therapeutic strategy for CRC with improved efficacy and reduced side effects.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）患者预后不良且缺乏有效药物。双氢青蒿素（DHA）具有抗癌潜力，但其机制尚不明确。我们阐明了DHA对CRC发展的影响及其机制，旨在为CRC提供一种有效、低毒性的药物及新策略。本研究采用增殖实验、transwell实验、血管生成实验、转移模型、PDX模型及AOM/DSS模型来揭示DHA对CRC的作用。通过RNA-seq、ChIP、分子对接、pull down及双荧光素酶报告基因实验鉴定了关键通路和靶点。结果显示，DHA对CRC的生长、转移和血管生成表现出强烈的抑制作用，且无明显毒性，其抑制效果与临床药物卡培他滨（Cap）相似。确实，DHA直接靶向GSK-3beta，通过GSK-3beta/TCF7/MMP9通路抑制CRC发展。有意义的是，DHA与Cap联合使用增强了抗癌效果，并减轻了Cap诱导的腹泻、免疫抑制和炎症。总之，DHA有潜力成为治疗CRC的有效且低毒性药物。此外，DHA与Cap联合使用可能成为CRC的一种新治疗策略，具有更好的疗效和更少的副作用。
